svg.title: Pediatric asthma decision chart: red flags send a wheezy child to a non-asthma diagnosis; otherwise age decides how asthma is confirmed (documented obstruction and reversibility under 6, lung function tests from 6) and how treatment steps up (LTRA under 6, more ICS at 6 to 11, LABA from 12)
